<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="description" content="Course information and resources for EC7210 Macroeconomics, Fall 2026.">
  <title>EC7210 Macroeconomics</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      color-scheme: light dark;
      --background: #ffffff;
      --text: #222222;
      --muted: #5b6470;
      --link: #0757a6;
      --border: #d9dee5;
    }

    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      :root {
        --background: #17191c;
        --text: #eeeeee;
        --muted: #b6bec8;
        --link: #7db9f2;
        --border: #3b4149;
      }
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      background: var(--background);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto,
        Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 1rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    main {
      width: min(100% - 2rem, 760px);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 3rem 0 4rem;
    }

    h1 {
      margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.4rem);
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    h2 {
      margin: 2.25rem 0 0.75rem;
      padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      font-size: 1.25rem;
    }

    p {
      margin: 0.75rem 0;
    }

    .meta {
      margin-top: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    ul {
      margin: 0.75rem 0;
      padding-left: 1.4rem;
    }

    li + li {
      margin-top: 0.6rem;
    }

    a {
      color: var(--link);
      text-underline-offset: 0.15em;
    }

    a:hover,
    a:focus-visible {
      text-decoration-thickness: 2px;
    }

    table {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0.75rem 0;
      border-collapse: collapse;
    }

    th,
    td {
      padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem 0.4rem 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      text-align: left;
    }

    th {
      font-weight: 600;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main>
    <header>
      <h1>EC7210 Macroeconomics</h1>
      <p class="meta">Fall 2026</p>
    </header>

    <p>
      This page provides supplementary material for EC7210 Macroeconomics, a
      first-semester course in the Master's Program in Economics at Stockholm
      University.
    </p>

    <p>
      Stockholm University
      <a href="https://www.su.se/english/education/course-catalogue/ec/ec7210">course information</a>.
    </p>

    <p>
      Lecture notes and slides are available on the <a href="https://canvas.su.se/courses/13560">course page in Canvas</a>.
    </p>

    <h2>Lecture Notes 2: The Ramsey model</h2>
    <p>
      The scripts compute the transition from a given initial capital stock to
      the steady state with constant productivity and population. They also
      plot the transition path in the phase diagram.
    </p>
    <ul>
      <li><a href="RamseyModel.m" download>MATLAB version (RamseyModel.m)</a></li>
      <li><a href="RamseyModel.py" download>Python version (RamseyModel.py)</a></li>
    </ul>

    <h2>Lecture Notes 4: The real business cycle (RBC) model</h2>
    <p>
      The impulse-response scripts compute the responses illustrated in Figures 1 and 2 of Lecture Notes 4. To compare the two calibrations,
      run the script with different values of the labor-supply parameter <var>γ</var>. The simulation scripts plot a short sample from the simulated
      economy and compute the model moments reported in Table 1.
    </p>
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th scope="col">Material</th>
          <th scope="col">MATLAB</th>
          <th scope="col">Python</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td>Impulse responses</td>
          <td><a href="rbc_ir.m" download>rbc_ir.m</a></td>
          <td><a href="rbc_ir.py" download>rbc_ir.py</a></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td>Simulation</td>
          <td><a href="rbc_with_simulation.m" download>rbc_with_simulation.m</a></td>
          <td><a href="rbc_with_simulation.py" download>rbc_with_simulation.py</a></td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>

    <h2>Macroeconomic data</h2>
    <ul>
      <li>
        <strong>International organizations:</strong>

  </main>

</html>
